summary: Iteration 3 tested only the frontend fix for 'login option not visible on mobile'. Everything passed. At 390x844, 360x740, 768x1024 and also 320x640, header-account-link is visible. Header icons do not overlap each other or the logo (checked with bounding boxes). No horizontal scroll: scrollWidth equals viewport width. Tapping the account icon as a guest opens /login. The drawer button mobile-nav-signin-button sits at the top and reads 'SIGN IN / REGISTER' for guests; it opens /login and closes the drawer. Mobile login with the t1shopper account works and lands on /account. After login, the account icon has href /account and aria-label 'My account'. The drawer button then reads 'MY ACCOUNT', opens /account and closes. The desktop header at 1920x800 is unchanged: search overlay, mega menu on hover, bag drawer, wishlist page, account link and nav links all work, and the mobile buttons are hidden.

issues: Icon buttons shrink to 32x36px (max-[360px]:h-9 w-8), below the 44px touch-target guideline. Acceptable but tight.
At 320px the logo is only about 4px from the search icon and about 4px from the account icon. It does not overlap, but it looks cramped.

action_items: Optional: at 360px and below, consider keeping touch targets at least 40px, or hiding the wishlist icon (it is reachable from the drawer)
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: the max-[360px] variant also matches exactly 360px, so 360x740 phones get the smaller 32x36 buttons. Intentional, but worth knowing
MobileNav.jsx: the account link appears twice (top button and footer mobile-nav-account). This is redundant but harmless
